name: mcp-exposure-without-element
description: An exposure.list reply without the element list is not a list of the exposure, and the server rejects it when it builds the tools.
reason: The host always holds the element list in exposure.list (packages/host/go/src/endpoint.go:1451 adds it when the page omits it), so the host never gives this reply. The case checks the rejection of a reply that lacks the list.
